recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13356; any future change to the legacy extension-pack artifact belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack repository, and any new ClinicalDocument profile should be handled as a new SDWG project.
issue_request: FHIR-13356 was a Published FHIR-core / Structured Documents change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking whether Composition needed a CDA ClinicalDocument.versionNumber equivalent and deciding to add a standard extension for recording that version in the ClinicalDocument on FHIR profile.
initial_application: Commit ab4c4aa3eb2b890c90489e60f06a124b0d556fae, titled GF#13356 - add extension for versionNumber on Composition, applied the issue historically as the Jira comment's svn revision 13100. The original application used ClinicalDocument profile/extension content rather than a base Composition element.
additional_context: Later core history added Composition.version with a CDA .versionNumber mapping, then removed the ClinicalDocument profile and versionNumber extension hooks under FHIR-34407 and FHIR-38201 because Composition.version replaced the extension for R5 and later. FHIR-38000 cited Composition.version as the accepted model for DocumentReference.version. The FHIR Extension Pack still contains composition-clinicaldocument-versionNumber, but it is marked with endFhirVersion 4.3 and directs R5+ users to Composition.version.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No core source edit is needed because Composition is active, Composition.version is present in the current source, the old ClinicalDocument profile/extension hooks are absent from active core source, and the remaining extension-pack artifact is intentionally external and legacy-scoped.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied SDWG decision removed the ClinicalDocument profile because Composition.version replaced the versionNumber extension; already represented on the combined branch by d6987fb0def186b631b3883a563f09dcc601b039.
